verdict.rationale: Forwarding original documents such as certified mail and checks is a fair question for a registered-agent service, so the axis applies. The pack has no first-party content: the site returned a Cloudflare challenge on robots.txt. The only community item is about the company's SEO visibility, which is off-topic, so nothing documents a forwarding policy.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, original documents are forwarded under a documented policy, so certified mail and checks reach the company
